Complaint Filed Against Congress Leaders Over Vande Mataram Incident

A complaint has been filed against Congress leaders Sonia Gandhi, Rahul Gandhi, and Mallikarjun Kharge, alleging disruption during the singing of the national song 'Vande Mataram'. The complaint claims the incident occurred at an Independence Day celebration. Delhi Police have initiated an inquiry into the matter, reportedly examining video evidence and media reports. The BJP has lodged protests in Jalandhar regarding the alleged disrespect. Separately, a Congress leader described the BJP's protest as a "diversionary tactic."
